```python
# Edge case: current song missing from queue -> like whole queue
access_token = apis.spotify.access_token_from(main_user)
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
queue = apis.spotify.show_song_queue(access_token=access_token)
if not queue:
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(status="success")
    return
ids = [s.song_id for s in queue]
if current and current.song_id in ids:
    ids = ids[:ids.index(current.song_id)+1]
for sid in ids:
    apis.spotify.like_song(access_token=access_token, song_id=sid, raise_on_failure=False)
apis.supervisor.complete_task(status="success")
```
